_comment: Google TPU v7 'Ironwood' (2025), single-accelerator = 1 chip (2 compute dies/TensorCores). Backing HBM3e -> on-chip VMEM (SRAM, estimated) -> compute leaf (TensorCore). ICI/superpod fabric omitted per single-accelerator convention. Vendor headline (HBM BW/cap, BF16/FP8 peak, ICI, TensorCore count) = GOLD from Google Cloud tpu7x docs; MXU 256x256 + 1.1GHz clock = third-party/derived (SILVER); VMEM size/BW + HBM energy = estimate (BRONZE).

provenance.source: docs.cloud.google.com/tpu/docs/tpu7x (HBM 192 GiB = 206158430208 B; 7380 GBps = 7.38e12 B/s); cloud.google.com inside-Ironwood blog; ServeTheHome Hot Chips 2025. energy 5.0/5.5 pJ/B = BRONZE estimate (HBM3e; H100 HBM3 7 pJ/B baseline, undisclosed by Google).

VMEM per-TensorCore software scratchpad UNDISCLOSED by Google. 128 MiB/TensorCore x2 = 256 MiB/chip (268435456 B) estimated from jax-ml scaling-book + generational trend; BW ~22x HBM (scaling-book v5p/v6e VMEM:HBM ratio) = 1.62e14. DIRECTIONAL ONLY; both verifiers flag unverifiable.

peak_macs_per_s derived from GOLD vendor BF16 peak 2307 TFLOPs (docs tpu7x): /2 FLOP-per-MAC /2 TensorCores = 5.7675e14 MAC/s each; instances=2 TensorCores GOLD (docs tpu7x). matrix_unit 256x256 third-party (Hot Chips 2025/SemiAnalysis, up from 128x128 in v5p), k=256 representative tile depth. clock 1.1 GHz third-party (The Register); self-consistent: 2*65536 MAC/cyc *16 MXU *1.1e9 = 2.307e15 FLOP/s = official BF16 peak.

fabric_omitted.note: GOLD vendor value but omitted per single-accelerator convention
